_doc: Triage of the client-eye gate findings (run 2026-11-06). Rules are matched in order on check (+ option) and a regex over « text || note || element || pages ». REAL = a defect in our product or our text. FALSE-POSITIVE = the rule was wrong; the reason names the tightening made in the gate code. UNVERIFIED = could not be decided from this environment (listed under « could not check »). « ce » groups findings that are one defect.

rules.reason: R2: every remaining shift is WordPress core (media-new, post-new for pages and congresses); the plugin screens (Demandes detail, Accès GM&E) no longer shift. Known and out of our control, accepted by the operator.
R2: « Auteur/autrice » is WordPress core's French column heading (inclusive spelling), a valid word.
R2: « Reconnectez-vous » is correct French (imperative with hyphen); the spell list lacks the verb form. This is the new « Votre session a expiré » message.
R2 NEW: the Pages list (now open to Direction) shows WordPress's default draft page in English, « Privacy Policy — Brouillon », inside a French screen. Seed or retitle it in the blueprint.
R2: « one » is a pronoun (« each time you open one of these links »), not a number.
R2: « 24 hours without use » is traced: the nightly purge keys on sandboxes.last_seen (custom_demo/src/data.js:14), and C7 passes on the idle rule.
R2 NEW: « a slot within 3 to 5 working days of your notice » (site/demo/index.html:499) is a time promise with no source line in the repository. Trace it or remove the figure.

R2: the hub now says « the code stays hidden until you click « Afficher le code »: that click is needed », so the click is documented. The gate rule was stale and is tightened (it flags only when the hub step does not name the label).
R2: gate artefact. The C2 probe clicked WordPress's « Replier le menu », which persists per user and folded the admin menu for the next sign-in. Tightened: that button is no longer probed.

The one hosted boot of the admin link stayed on « Preparing WordPress » at 50 % for 120 s (shots hosted-admin-*.png); the visitor link, same blueprint steps minus « login », was ready in 15.7 s. One boot per link (brief) cannot tell a stall from this sandbox's network. Needs one human boot of the admin link.
sft.fr answers 403 to scripted clients and to a real Chromium tab from this sandbox (a browser user-agent probe was refused by the auto-mode classifier). Needs one click from an ordinary browser.
Every congress page links « Site officiel » to https://example.com/congres/cg-0xxx, which answers 404: a reader who clicks it lands on an error page.
Every congress page links « Site officiel » to https://www.example.org/…, which answers 404: a reader who clicks it lands on an error page.
The CSV download name uses gmdate('Ymd') (UTC): an export made between 00:00 and 01:00 Paris is named with yesterday's date.

B decides « today » with UTC today() in the catalogue past filter, the public fare notice, enquiry and traveller date validation, the ended-congress 404, group link state and both CSV file names; the 00:05 Paris probe shows today()=06/11 while Paris is 07/11. parisToday() exists and is used elsewhere.
A word is split across two lines without a hyphen (« d’ophtalmologie » in the Demandes table at 1280).

Congress titles in A use an ordinary space before « — exemple », so « — exemple » wraps alone onto the next line (catalogue, congress page, admin lists, at every width). B fixed this with non-breaking spaces.
The « Lien de groupe » card text « … aux 6 participants : chacun … » has an ordinary space before « : », which starts a line at 390.
Concept pages (/ and /console/) show sample titles whose « — exemple » wraps alone onto the next line at 320–768.
« Précisions » is quoted with ordinary spaces on /questions/: « or » end/start a line at 320 and 768.

The French note for ASSET uses ordinary spaces inside « » and before ; and :, so « ends lines and » ; : start lines (e.g. « la carte « Voyages d’affaires » », « © 2026 »), at all six widths. Source site/pour-asset/index.html uses U+0020 there.

WordPress shows « Se déconnecter » only in the account menu that opens on hover; the inventory records what is visible without hovering. The C10 replay hovered and clicked it (T5.2). Not tightened: the inventory stays « visible without interaction », the term is checked by C10.
A says « Ajouter un congrès », B « Nouveau congrès ».
A says « Journal des notifications » (the hub quotes it), B « Notifications ».
A heads the form « Demander un devis vol » (the hub quotes it), B « Demande de devis vol ».
A « Envoyer ma demande », B « Envoyer la demande ».
A « Approuver (24 h) », B « Approuver pour 24 h ».
A « Révéler le code », B « Afficher le code ».
A « Journal GM&E », B « Journal » (menu) / « Journal d’accès ».
A « Exporter en CSV », B « Exporter (tableur CSV) ».
A « Accès GM&E », B « Codes » under the heading « Codes GM&E » (the hub quotes « Codes GM&E »).
Same defect as CE-C10-002: the hub tells the reader to open « Codes GM&E », the clickable menu label is « Codes ».

The hub quotes the counter's shape « répondus / attendus », not a label; the UI shows « 3 répondus / 6 attendus ». Tightened in the glossary check: a quote that is a counter pattern is matched as a substring (not done in code; recorded here).
Same defect as CE-D1-001: the role the hub's admin link signs in as is refused the Pages screen (403).

WordPress core's admin-ajax « wp-compression-test » answers 400 in Playground, logging console errors on admin pages. Invisible to a reader, but the rule is zero console errors; platform-level, check again on real hosting.
The dashboard widget's « Monter » is aria-disabled (first widget): the reader is told it is unavailable. Tightened: C2 now skips disabled / aria-disabled buttons.

WordPress core's #titlediv .inside (it later holds the permalink line) is empty on a new congress: 25 px of blank space with no border or background, not a visible empty box. Tightened: C3 only flags empty containers that have a border, a background or a shadow.
The extra families are WordPress core chrome (« Options de l’écran » tab, login page), not our buttons. Kept visible in the report; the plugin's own buttons are one family.
The console login page sets its heading in EB Garamond, every other console screen in Inter.
Buttons on the concept pages (/ and /console/) are uppercase monospace, on the demos hub Inter sentence case: the five pages linked from the hub do not share one button style.
Option A's public site uses two accent hues (orange buttons, blue links).
The hub never says that each person's trial is private to their browser (B's own login page does).
The hub says the sandboxes « reset themselves » but not when (B: nightly purge of trials older than 24 h; A: on reload).
When the WordPress session ends, the reader is sent to wp-login.php?reauth=1 with no message saying the session expired.
A form sent from an open tab after the session ended shows « Session requise »: it does not say the session expired, and the note typed is lost.
After the session ends, the next click lands on the login page with no « Session expirée » message.

The 03:00 UTC purge deletes sandboxes CREATED more than 24 h ago (data.js nightly, created_at < cutoff), so a trial in use at 03:00 that began the previous day is wiped mid-session. The rule is « idle for more than 24 h ».
Residue of this QA's own debug script on the local server (port 9437), not seed data. Not a rule issue: the final A run uses a fresh database (port 9439).
Hub A task 5 step 3 says « the code is shown »; the reader must still click « Révéler le code » (one extra click the hub does not mention).
Hub B task 5 says open « Codes GM&E »; in the console that text is a non-clickable group heading, the link under it says « Codes ».
The hub marks « Editing all the site’s pages » as « Works in the demo » for A, and says the admin link signs in as « direction »; direction gets 403 on Pages (edit.php?post_type=page).
The e-mail error message gives « prenom.nom@societe.fr » as the example: societe.fr is a real domain; use @example.com like the rest of the demo.
Seeded phones 01 23 45 67 01–06 are ordinary assignable Paris numbers, not in the ARCEP fiction range (01 99 00 xx xx) and not masked; they show in enquiries and the notification log.
The concept page shows ASSET's phone 01 55 57 29 00; the address is traced (advisory/src/part1.md:76, RFP letterhead) but the phone is not traced to any source in the repository. Trace or remove.

Concept pages list « Congrès européen de radiologie — exemple » (the French name of ECR, Vienna, late February: the real congress) and « Congrès mondial de neurologie » (WCN). « — exemple » does not make the name fictional.
A's seed has « Congrès européen de radiologie — exemple » in Vienna 24–28 Feb 2027: the real ECR's French name, city and season.
B's seed has « Congrès européen de radiologie — exemple » (Vienna, 24–28 Feb 2027, the real ECR) and « Congrès mondial de neurologie — exemple » (WCN).
« Try it in five minutes » is a time promise with no source and no measurement (the robot replay alone took 82 s for B, without reading).
« DEMO-GME-XXXX » is the format hint (placeholder) in Direction's code field, not a code. Tightened: CODE_RE excludes XXXX.
Same defect as CE-B4-004, seen on the hosted visitor link too.
Same defect as CE-D2-002, seen on the hosted visitor link too.
URL slugs in WordPress' « Identifiant » column. Tightened: words in td.column-slug are no longer collected for B5.
The login name shown in the « Identifiant » field of the profile screen: correct as typed.
Random stamp in the title of the congress this run created (« Congrès de relecture xxxx — exemple »).
WordPress core « Publier tout de suite » followed by the « Modifier » link, separated by CSS margin, not by a space character: the eye reads two words.
Console line of the same WordPress core admin-ajax « wp-compression-test » 400 (CE-C1-001).

Hosted Playground pages exist only inside the visitor's own tab (service worker), so an outside checker gets 404. Tightened: A4 skips wpsandbox.wordpress.net/scope: URLs (the same links are checked on the local build).
WordPress' « Identifiant » column shows URL slugs, accent-free by design. Tightened: B7 skips td.column-slug.
